description: The limits of AXT: every bound on a size, a count, a length, a depth or a time that the specification sets, by name. The documents of spec/ name the limits that apply; the numbers are here. Sizes are in bytes, lengths of text in bytes of UTF-8 unless the unit says otherwise, and times in seconds. CC0 1.0.

envelope.message.what: One message, its single-object header included; also the payload of a MESSAGE frame

envelope.schema.what: One schema as JSON text; also a description in its Avro encoding and the text of its derived schema

envelope.schema_depth.what: The nesting depth of a schema's JSON text

envelope.file_metadata.what: The metadata of a file, keys and values together

envelope.file_block.what: One data block of a file, after decompression

envelope.file_data.what: All data blocks of a file together, after decompression

types.data_depth.what: The data depth of a record, the record itself at depth 1

time.zone.what: The name of a zone in an axt.DateTime

metadata.label.what: The label in the texts of a typed field, an enum symbol or a group, and each value of its label_translations

metadata.help.what: The help in the texts of a typed field, an enum symbol or a group, and each value of its help_translations

metadata.placeholder.what: The placeholder of a brick of text or of numbers

metadata.example.what: The example of a brick of text or of numbers

metadata.translations.what: Entries of one label_translations or help_translations

metadata.emoji.what: The emoji in the texts of a typed field, an enum symbol or a group

metadata.pattern_quantifier.what: Each number of a range quantifier in a pattern, as in {2,4}

metadata.group_key.what: A group key, in the group of a typed field and in the groups of an axt.ObjectField

manifest.body.what: The body of a MANIFEST message, its single-object header included

manifest.full_name.what: A full name in takes or sends

manifest.purpose.what: One purpose sentence, in English or another language

manifest.language_tag.what: A language tag, in a manifest and in the translations of field metadata and bricks

protocol.offer_types.what: Entries of types in one OFFER, ACCEPT or DECLINE

protocol.ack_records.what: Entries of records in one ACK

protocol.error_record_id.what: The id of the reported message's record, up to which an ERROR carries record

protocol.error_field.what: The field path in an ERROR; a longer path is reported as null

protocol.manifest_wait.what: How long an app waits for the other app's valid MANIFEST after a live connection opens

protocol.ack_wait.what: Within which a receiver sends the ACK after processing a record message, a CHANGE, a FORWARD or a WITHDRAW

protocol.answer_wait.what: Within which an app answers an offered type it decides on its own; also the ACCEPT for an offer of a device of the own set

protocol.idle_wait.what: After which a sender may close a connection in which nothing but unanswered types has happened

sync.change_fields.what: Entries of fields in a CHANGE

sync.change_field_name.what: A name in the fields of a CHANGE

shares.proposal_fields.what: Entries of fields in one PROPOSAL

shares.proposal_field_name.what: A field name in a PROPOSAL

shares.proposal_value_bytes.what: The value bytes of one PROPOSAL, the value of every entry together

shares.open_value_bytes.what: The value bytes of the open proposals of one proposer in all, at a device

shares.open_per_record.what: Open proposals of one proposer for one record, at a device

shares.open.what: Open proposals of one proposer in all, at a device

fields.depth.what: The depth of typed fields in a description, the root at depth 1

fields.long_default.what: The magnitude of a default of axt.LongField, 2^53

fields.offer_data_depth.what: The data depth up to which a receiver decodes the body of an OFFER

fields.relations.what: Relations in one list of relations

fields.relation_name.what: The kind of a relation, and the type of a record target

fields.relation_uri.what: The uri of an outside target

fields.relation_text.what: The display text of a target

fields.relation_attributes.what: Entries of the attributes of a relation

fields.relation_attribute_name.what: A name in the attributes of a relation

fields.relation_attribute_value.what: A value in the attributes of a relation

fields.extensions.what: Extensions in one list of extensions

fields.extension_data.what: The data of an extension, its single-object header included

transports.qr_addresses.what: Addresses in the local part of a QR payload

transports.qr_payload.what: A QR payload: one with every field present and at its largest, its array in one block

transports.qr_text.what: The text of a QR code: the text of the largest valid payload

transports.open_wait.what: Within which a live connection is open after its TCP connection

transports.ping_interval.what: After which an app that has sent no frame sends a PING

transports.idle_wait.what: After which an app closes a connection on which it has received no frame

transports.relay_url.what: The base URL of a relay, also relay.url in a manifest and a QR payload

transports.retry_first.what: The wait before the first repeat of a request after a failure without Retry-After

transports.retry_longest.what: The longest wait between two repeats of a request, which doubles from the first

transports.list_messages.what: Messages in the response to one list

transports.list_wait.what: The largest wait of a list

transports.list_interval.what: The shortest time between two lists of a mailbox without wait

transports.holding.what: The holding time: how long a relay holds a message after its put, and after which a sender sends a message without an outcome again

transports.longest_holding.what: The longest a relay holds a message after its put, by which it has deleted it; how long an app keeps what a message from a relay may still need

transports.mailbox_idle.what: The time without an owner request after which a relay may remove a mailbox, and before which it must not

transports.sealed_message.what: The largest sealed message, a message of envelope.message sealed and padded, which every relay accepts
